summary: Round 4 fixes verified end-to-end. Backend (7/7 pytest passing): Grade 3 now has Garden access (200) and Investments blocked (400 with 'Use /garden/farm' message); Grade 4 has Investments (200) and Garden blocked (400/403 with 'Grade 1-3 only'); Grade 1 Garden still 200. Seed catalog for Grade 3 returns all 5 expected seeds (Red Chilli, Tomato, Eggplant, Wheat, Strawberry) — endpoint used: /api/investments/plants. Frontend UI (screenshots): (a) classmate_g3 dashboard shows 'My Garden' nav card with 🌱 and 'Plant your first seed' subtitle; clicking navigates to /garden which loads Money Garden UI with visible seed shop (Red Chilli/Tomato/Eggplant visible in Market card, Wheat/Strawberry likely below fold in scrollable list). (b) classmate_g1 leaderboard shows exactly 3 rows (Demo Kid, Cara G3, You) — capped correctly from 5. Leaderboard height 172px vs savings 96px — both compact, no large empty whitespace. (c) classmate_g4_qa dashboard unchanged (light-blue bg, Learn/My Money/Quests/Money Words tiles, no My Garden, no hero, has old detailed cards). No regressions observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/garden/buy-plot returns HTTP 403 for Grade 4 while /api/garden/farm returns 400 with a redirect message — inconsistent status codes for the same grade-gate concept. Consider standardizing to 403 or 400 across all garden routes.
Login response uses 'session_token' key (not 'access_token' or 'token') and login body requires 'identifier' (not 'username'/'email') — worth documenting in API docs for test-agent efficiency.
